lines.trans: Then let us call that company right now.
I just flagged down the first car on the street.
Where will we find that driver now?
It is fine, tomorrow they will make me a new card.
And then I will immediately settle up with you in full.
Alright, I am waiting, just call me Viktor Petrovich in the kitchen.
Viktor Petrovich, they just delivered fresh raisins to us.
Only we asked for regular ones, and Timur brought seedless grapes.
And he does not want to listen to me there at all.
Alright, it is time for me to go and work with the groceries.
Of course I understand, if anything comes up, I am in my room.

examples.text: Там сейчас свежее мясо должны привезти, проконтролируй.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'сить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to ask (for)', paired with 'попросить'.

examples.text: Только мы просили обычный, а Тимур привёз кишмиш.

examples.trans: She herself asked her brother to play along with her this morning.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ычный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('ordinary, regular').

examples.text: Только мы просили обычный, а Тимур привёз кишмиш.
